claim: Of [13a] The master-key opened the door and [13b] The door opened with the master-key, “for further discussion of these constructions see Ch. 4, §8.3.3”.
evidence_summary: Ch. 4, §8.3.3 (p. 319), is “Type III: I wiped the marks off the wall vs I wiped the wall”, with wash in [74] and brush, dust and others in [75]. The master-key pair is [76i] in §8.3.4, “Type IV: We filled the bucket with water vs Water filled the bucket”: We opened the door with the master-key / The master-key opened the door. Page 320 covers [13b]: “Only [i] and [iv] allow a third construction”.
finding: Change §8.3.3 to §8.3.4. Both subsections begin on p. 319.
inference: Does the cited section discuss the master-key constructions?

evidence.passage: §2.2, p. 674. “for further discussion of these constructions see Ch. 4, §8.3.3”.
